benchmark_camera_scope: Fitted full room footprints; camera restored before each independent action. Hull geometry coverage does not account for HUD occlusion.
draw_timing_scope: Accumulator read on every measured sample, after draining warm-up; other observers may also drain it. Callback count is not a count of whole-station redraws. Engine wait excludes report collection.
engine_process_time_scope: TIME_PROCESS and TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS are previous reporting-second maxima, not current-frame durations; profile_mean averages sampled maxima.
input_scope: Physical viewport input disabled; workload actions call game methods. This does not certify actual keyboard, mouse or trackpad interaction.
loading_scope: Initial save/new game only; synthetic fixture preparation is measured separately
render_timing_scope: Compatibility CPU/GPU viewport timings are delayed engine query results, not aligned current-frame costs; do not add them to script or frame wall timings.
